Title: 7 Steps to Plan a Small Laundry: Layouts, Tubs and Storage
Description: Small laundry ideas in 7 steps: a stacked washer and dryer beside a laundry tub on one wall, machines side by side under a benchtop, a galley laundry with shelves opposite, a laundry in a small bathroom and a tub set into the benchtop. The guide gives layouts in millimetres, appliance and tub sizes, waterproofing and dryer rules for Australian homes, and how to store detergents safely.
